name: Bin-Hash Index Construction
aliases: GPU-based Query-Driven Visualization with Bin-Hash Index
definition: An index construction strategy for AMR data that accelerates query performance by utilizing multi-resolution information, generating both an encoded low-resolution version and a spatially compacted full-resolution version of the data.
summary: Bin-Hash Index Construction is a GPU-based indexing strategy for AMR data that accelerates queries by generating low-resolution encoded arrays and spatially compacted full-resolution hash tables for fast coarse filtering and precise access.
